channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: The edge is where attackers get in: this week's firewall, VPN and remote-access exploits
item.description: Five exploited flaws in firewalls, VPNs, remote-support software and file-sharing servers show one pattern. The systems that sit at the edge of your network, and that administrators manage remotely, are the weakest link. Here is what to check first.

item.title: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: what the Microsoft feed shows and what to do
item.description: The Microsoft feed lists few entries, and most of them are updates to October's release rather than new fixes. The one item that needs planning is a .NET remote code execution flaw that Microsoft has not fixed yet. Identity Web and WSL need version checks if you use them.

item.title: Weekly M365 & Entra Briefing: 13 to 19 October 2026
item.description: Exchange sign-in problems after October Windows Server updates, an identity-based incident at ConnectWise that affected Microsoft 365 tenants, and why device-code abuse is still worth a Conditional Access check.

item.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
item.description: Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks all had vulnerabilities in edge devices come under fire this week. Now BeyondTrust joins the group.

item.title: Arista Warns of Critical VeloCloud SQL Injection Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Attackers are exploiting a zero-day SQL injection flaw in Arista's VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO), the central management system for VeloCloud SD-WAN networks, the company said in an advisory on October 22. The flaw lets anyone who can log in to the orchestrator, even with a read-only customer account, gain operator…

item.title: Microsoft Links Storm-0940 to ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
item.description: The China-linked actor used an AI-enabled penetration-testing tool to automate and accelerate its attack on more than 2,200 tenants.

item.title: New Serious PHP Vulnerabilities Released and Patched
item.description: PHP maintainers have released fixes for two critical vulnerabilities: PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 fix two critical vulnerabilities that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. All PHP users are strongly encouraged to update immediately. Who is at risk: all PHP installations serving web requests…

item.title: CVE-2026-108456 Azure AI Foundry Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description: Server-side request forgery (ssrf) in Azure AI Foundry allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

item.title: Qilin and INC Ransomware Groups Exploit Palo Alto Networks Flaw to Bypass MFA
item.description: Palo Alto Networks has disclosed that it's continuing to observe exploitation of a now-patched security flaw impacting PAN-OS and Prisma Access by ransomware actors. The activity relates to CVE-2026-0257 (CVSS score: 7.8), an authentication bypass flaw that could be exploited by bad actors to set up unauthorized VPN…

item.title: 'PHP2Shell' Bugs Signal Red Alert for Security Industry
item.description: Security teams are scrambling to remediate two critical PHP vulnerabilities following leaked details and reports of exploitation attempts.

item.title: CISA: SafePay ransomware hit over 600 critical infrastructure orgs
item.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) says the SafePay ransomware gang has breached over 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide since 2024.

item.title: Machine speed attacks require machine speed detection and response
item.description: Attackers can steal credentials and begin exfiltrating data within minutes, often before security teams can respond. Exaforce examines real-world attacks involving stolen GitHub tokens, malicious AI installers, and MFA phishing, explaining why faster detection and automated containment are critical.

item.description: Amazon's Threat Intelligence team on Wednesday said it detected an attempt to exploit the newly disclosed PHP2Shell vulnerabilities dating back to October 17, 2026, against its MadPot honeypot service, as the flaws come under broad exploitation in the wild following the release of the patches. item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added four vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, including four vulnerabilities impacting Plex Media Server that's collectively called Plex2Shell. item.description: Kurzer Nachtrag vom Oktober 2026-Patchday bei Microsoft. Redmond hat zum 13. Oktober 2026 mit den Sicherheitsupdates auch eine Funktion namens "Quick Machine Recovery" für Windows Server 2025 ausgeliefert. item.title: Railway warns devs to rotate secrets after potential breach
item.description: Cloud platform Railway published an urgent warning to users after detecting suspicious activity on its systems that store customer environment variables earlier this week.

item.title: Microsoft blames ConnectWise attacks on Chinese state hacker using ARTEX AI agents
item.description: A Chinese government-aligned hacking group used automated tools to carry out the recent supply chain attack on IT management software company ConnectWise and is using the same techniques to try to compromise organizations around the globe, Microsoft said.

item.title: CVE-2026-105014 Azure Pipelines Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command ('command injection') in Azure Pipelines allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-96185 Microsoft Exchange Online Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Online allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-96303 Microsoft PowerShell Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
item.description: Corrected Fixed Build Number and Download links in the Security Updates table. This is an informational change only.

item.description: Unknown threat actors breached TeamUpdraft's website and potentially gained unauthorized access to customers' connection keys for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone, using them to backdoor WordPress sites. TeamUpdraft is the developer behind UpdraftPlus, a popular WordPress backup plugin with over four…

item.description: State Bank of India has identified 3,897 customer records containing personal information in a set of about 375,000 records available on the dark web, and it does not yet know where the data came from. The state-owned bank, India's largest, said in a stock-exchange filing dated October 21 that it "has experienced an…

item.description: Siemens has addressed a DLL sideloading vulnerability impacting Siemens Software Center that it said has been exploited in ClickFix attacks. item.title: State Bank of India Suffers a Customer PII Data Leak
item.description: Relatively small data breaches in India can turn quite serious, thanks to a sophisticated underground market for trading PII.

item.title: Toronto crime tips org freezes operations after details of data breach come to light
item.description: Late Wednesday night the Toronto chapter of Crime Stoppers broke ranks with the national association, revealing a timeline showing what it knew and when along with an announcement that it will pause operations.

item.title: Capcom confirms data breach affecting 11.7 million accounts
item.description: Japanese gaming giant Capcom has confirmed that hackers breached its membership service, CAPCOM ID, exposing more than 11.7 million customer email addresses and associated information.

item.description: Der Oktober 2026 dürfte für IT-Mitarbeiter nicht als besonderer "Wonne-Monat" in die Geschichte eingehen. item.title: Microsoft shares how to fix broken Exchange Online EWS apps
item.description: Microsoft says IT admins can re-enable the retired Exchange Web Services (EWS) API in Exchange Online to fix EWS apps that have stopped working.

The world’s largest cloud computing provider on Wednesday said it had identified an attempt by…

item.title: Cybercrime crackdown across Africa leads to 1,462 arrests, $105 million seized
item.description: More than 1,400 suspected cybercriminals were arrested across Africa this summer as part of a crackdown on the gangs perpetrating online fraud, ransomware and business email compromise attacks, Interpol said.

item.title: Cisco Patches 34 Vulnerabilities Across Multiple Products
item.description: Critical-severity security defects could lead to command execution, authentication bypass, and XSS attacks. The post Cisco Patches 34 Vulnerabilities Across Multiple Products appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Authorities disrupt nearly 11,000 cybercrime networks in Africa
item.description: Law enforcement agencies have disrupted nearly 11,000 cybercriminal networks and arrested more than 1,400 people in Operation Serengeti III, which targeted business email compromise, ransomware, and online scams.

item.title: Oracle Patches Over 1,200 Vulnerabilities With October 2026 CPU
item.description: Nearly 100 vulnerabilities have been assigned a critical severity rating and Fusion Middleware received the most patches. The post Oracle Patches Over 1,200 Vulnerabilities With October 2026 CPU appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: TiDB Breach Exposes Flawed Cloud Security Assumptions
item.description: Cloud providers may be storing sensitive customer data, without either party knowing it. But when a provider is breached, the data comes home to roost.

item.title: Marvell, Microsoft & Oracle Work to Standardize Data Center Hardware Security
item.description: The effort is aimed at standardizing a NIST FIPS 140-3 Level 3 integrated HSM for cloud and hyperscale data center infrastructure.

item.title: PHP says AI review of critical bugs first sparked alarm in August, but signs surfaced in 2024
item.description: In a lengthy statement about two critical vulnerabilities, the PHP Foundation explained how one dated to 2024, how a recent third-party review by AI companies heightened attention on both, why it scrambled to post information earlier than planned.

item.title: High-Severity Flaws Exploited in Three Days as Ransomware Dominates Q3: Rapid7
item.description: Rapid7’s Q3 analysis finds high-severity flaws exploited within three days on average, while AI appeared in just 8% of tracked incidents. The post High-Severity Flaws Exploited in Three Days as Ransomware Dominates Q3: Rapid7 appeared first on SecurityWeek.
